output.reason: PMK 66/2023 makes benefits in kind (natura/kenikmatan) received by employees part of their taxable income, which enters the gross income for PPh 21 of permanent employees. It sets exclusions and thresholds, for example meal coupons up to Rp2,000,000 per month and specified types and limits. It also sets valuation rules (market value or cost) and requires withholding by the employer at the end of the month of transfer, starting with the July 2023 tax period. Benefits received from January to June 2023 are excluded from withholding and must be self-assessed by the recipient.
